title: AlignmentStabilityBench: Measuring How Alignment Properties Change with Model Scale

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: if alignment properties exhibit discontinuous jumps at scale, this is critical for deployment decisions. Empirical data on alignment scaling directly addresses a major open question about whether safety degrades unpredictably with model size.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Evaluating multiple model sizes on existing benchmarks is conceptually simple. Loading and running 1B, 3B, and 8B models requires medium compute and basic HuggingFace skills. Sycophancy and reward hacking probe sets may need construction.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three model sizes, three evaluation dimensions, plot scaling curves. Well-defined and achievable in 30 hours if using existing evaluation scripts for TruthfulQA and creating simple probe sets for the other dimensions.
